description:
Produce a committed extraction record in which the Charon/Aeneas toolchain run for the loop-free generic field operations completes cleanly and its generated output elaborates verbatim.

## Background

The spike record for trait-generic extraction (dev/active/34d85cb9/) documents an Aeneas invocation that exits 1: a blanket-default pow item the translator cannot handle poisons the run, and the generated Funs.lean elaborates only after the pow chain is deleted by hand. The proof-obligation sketch (dev/active/1ac74567/) elaborates its lemma statements against that manually reduced tree. The epic owner ruled that this does not demonstrate a successful extraction: the invocation itself must exit 0 and the output must elaborate as generated. The falsified pow item must therefore be excluded at the invocation boundary — for example by marking it opaque to the translation — not by editing generated output afterwards. The toolchain stays on the pinned Charon/Aeneas pair and the workspace MSRV; upstream migration is tracked separately.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed extraction record shows the Charon and Aeneas invocations for the FiniteFieldExt::square / frobenius class each completing with exit code 0 on the workspace MSRV toolchain with the pinned toolchain pair, with the falsified pow default excluded at the invocation boundary rather than by edits to generated output.
- [hard] REQ-02: The generated Lean output elaborates with exit code 0 after at most the committed fix-aeneas-dupes.py normalization — the named, tracked repair for the upstream duplicate clause-field emission (carve-out issue 2e544a34), sanctioned for this class by owner decision DEC-R (2026-08-23) — with no manual and no other post-generation edits, and the axiom dependencies of the extracted square and frobenius definitions are recorded.
- [hard] REQ-03: The proof-obligation sketch's lemma statements elaborate against the newly generated tree, and the prior spike and sketch records gain additive amendments citing the new record, changing no pre-existing line.

## Notes

- The duplicate-record-field emission is adjudicated: DEC-R sanctions the committed fix-aeneas-dupes.py normalization for it. Any OTHER criterion-blocking upstream defect: preserve the blocking evidence in the record and report it as a blocker instead of substituting a workaround.
- All extraction inputs, flags, logs, and generated files belong in the issue's dev/active area with a reproducible driver script.
title: Record a clean-exit extraction of the loop-free generic operations
